ash.m:

n. 灰, 灰烬

envelope.m:

spaceship.m: n a spacecraft designed to carry a crew into interstellar space (especially in science fiction)

probe.m:

n. a flexible slender surgical instrument with a blunt end that is used to explore wounds or body cavities

probe.zh:
n. 探索, 调查, 探针, 探测器

module.m:

n. computer circuit consisting of an assembly of electronic components (as of computer hardware)
n. a self-contained component (unit or item) that is used in combination with other components
module.zh:

propulsion.m:

n. the act of propelling
propulsion.zh:
n. 推进, 推进力

pressure.m:
n. the force applied to a unit area of surface; measured in pascals (SI unit) or in dynes (cgs unit)

motion.m:

n. a state of change

vent.m:

n. a fissure in the earth's crust (or in the surface of some other planet) through which molten lava and gases erupt

n. 排气口, 出口, 通风孔, 发泄

n. 尾部, 后部, 辫子, 随员, 特务, 燕尾服, 踪迹, 限定继承(权)

curve.m:

n. a line on a graph representing data

exploration.m:

n. a careful systematic search
n. a systematic consideration
exploration.zh:

expedition.m:
n. a military campaign designed to achieve a specific objective in a foreign country
n. an organized group of people undertaking a journey for a particular purpose

observatory.zh: n. 天文台, 气象台, 了望台

telescope.m:

v. crush together or collapse
v. make smaller or shorter
telescope.zh:
n. 望远镜
vi. 叠缩, 嵌进, 缩短

spectacle.m:

orbit.m:

diameter.m:

n. 直径

a. characteristic of a fossil

specimen.m:

specimen.zh:
n. 样品, 标本, 试料

particle.m:

molecule.zh:

atom.m:

atom.zh:
n. 原子, 核能, 微粒, 微量
[计] 原子

electron.m: n. an elementary particle with negative charge

quantum.m:
n. a discrete amount of something that is analogous to the quantities in quantum theory

quantum.zh:
n. 量, 量子

liquid.m:

n. 液体, 流体, 流音

fluid.m:

s. characteristic of a fluid; capable of flowing and easily changing shape

s. characterized by good substantial quality

vt.vi. 综合, 合成, 接合
vt. 用合成法合成, 综合地处理

synthesize.m:
v. combine so as to form a more complex, product

formation.m:
n. an arrangement of people or things acting as a unit
n. the act of fabricating something in a particular shape
n. a particular spatial arrangement
n. natural process that causes something to form
formation.zh:
n. 形成, 构造, 编队

method.m: n. a way of doing something, especially a systematic way; implies an orderly logical arrangement (usually in steps)
method.zh:
n. 方法, 办法, 条理, 秩序

spectrum.m:
n. an ordered array of the components of an emission or wave

spectrum.zh:
n. 光谱, 范围, 系列
[化] 光谱

dimension.m:
n. the magnitude of something in a particular direction (especially length or width or height)
n. one of three Cartesian coordinates that determine a position in space

dimension.zh:
n. 尺寸, 次元, 面积, 维数
vt. 标出尺寸

frequency.m:
n. the number of occurrences within a given time period

frequency.zh:
n. 频率, 频数

signal.m:

n. 信号, 暗号, 近因, 导火线

n. 天线, 触须, 触角

circuit.m:

university.m:

n. establishment where a seat of higher learning is housed, including administrative and living quarters as well as facilities for research and teaching

college.m:

n. an institution of higher education created to educate and grant degrees; often a part of a university
n. a complex of buildings in which an institution of higher education is housed
college.zh: n. 学院, 大学, 学会

institute.m:
n. an association organized to promote art or science or education

institute.zh:
n. 学会, 学院, 协会
vt. 创立, 开始, 制定, 任命

academy.m:
n. a secondary school (usually private)
n. an institution for the advancement of art or science or literature
n. a school for special training
n. a learned establishment for the advancement of knowledge
academy.zh: n. 学院, 院校, 学会

learn.m:
v. gain knowledge or skills
v. get to know or become aware of, usually accidentally

study.m:
n. applying the mind to learning and understanding a subject (especially by reading)
n. a state of deep mental absorption
n. a room used for reading and writing and studying

study.zh:
n. 学习, 研究, 学科, 论文, 求学, 书房, 试作

vi. 学习, 思索

acquire.m:

knowledge.m: n the psychological result of perception and learning and reasoning

expertise.m: n skillfulness by virtue of possessing special knowledge
expertise.zh:
n. 专家意见, 专门技术
[法] 专门知识, 专家意见

novice.m: n. someone new to a field or activity

recruit.m:

n. any new member or supporter (as in the armed forces)

n. 新兵, 新手, 新会员, 补给品
vt. 恢复, 补充, 充实, 征募
vi. 征募新兵, 复原, 得到补充

literate.m:
n. a person who can read and write
a. able to read and write
a. versed in literature; dealing with literature
s. knowledgeable and educated in one or several fields
literate.zh:
n. 学者

illiteracy.m:

numerate.m:

problem.m:
n. a state of difficulty that needs to be resolved
n. a question raised for consideration or solution
problem.zh:
n. 问题, 难题

issue.m:

n. one of a series published periodically
n. the act of providing an item for general use or for official purposes (usually in quantity)

n. 发行, 问题, 后果, 流出, 出口, 争端

affair.m:

affair.zh: n. 事件, 事务, 恋爱事件

controversial.m: a. marked by or capable of arousing controversy
controversial.zh: a. 争论的, 论争的, 被议论的

puzzle.m:

n. a game that tests your ingenuity

n. 难题, 迷惑

riddle.m:

n. a coarse sieve (as for gravel)

n. 谜, 谜语, 粗筛
vt. 解谜, 给...出谜, 筛, 寻根究底地检验, 充满于
vi. 出谜

obscure.m:

v. reduce a vowel to a neutral one, such as a schwa
v. make undecipherable or imperceptible by obscuring or concealing
obscure.zh:
a. 模糊的, 昏暗的, 难解的, 晦涩的, 偏僻的, 微贱的, 无名的

instill.m:

cram.m:

前缀, 称谓

noun.m:

singular.m:

n. 单数

eloquence.zh:

communicate.m:

n. crafty artfulness (especially in deception)
s. attractive especially by means of smallness or prettiness or quaintness
cunning.zh:
a. 狡猾的, 巧妙的, 可爱的
[法] 狡猾的的, 狡诈的, 熟练的

arbitrary.m: a. based on or subject to individual discretion or preference or sometimes impulse or caprice
arbitrary.zh: a. 任意的, 武断的, 专治的, 霸道的

ridiculous.m:
s inspiring scornful pity
s incongruous; inviting ridicule
s broadly or extravagantly humorous; resembling farce
ridiculous.zh: a. 荒谬的, 可笑的

stupid.m:
n. a person who is not very bright
a. lacking or marked by lack of intellectual acuity
stupid.zh: a. 愚蠢的, 麻木的

awkward.m:
s. causing inconvenience
a. lacking grace or skill in manner or movement or performance
s. difficult to handle or manage especially because of shape
s. not elegant or graceful in expression
awkward.zh: a. 笨拙的, 棘手的

clumsy.m:
s lacking grace in movement or posture
s not elegant or graceful in expression
s difficult to handle or manage especially because of shape
s showing lack of skill or aptitude
clumsy.zh: a. 笨拙的, 不雅观的, 粗陋的

careless.m:
a. marked by lack of attention or consideration or forethought or thoroughness; not careful
s. effortless and unstudied
s. (usually followed by `of') without due thought or consideration
careless.zh: a. 粗心的, 不关心的, 无忧无虑的

oblivious.m: s. (followed by `to' or `of') lacking conscious awareness of
oblivious.zh:
a. 遗忘的, 健忘的, 不知不觉的
[法] 忘却的, 健忘的, 不在意的

naughty.zh: a. 顽皮的, 没规矩的, 不适当的, 下流的

greedy.m: s. wanting to eat or drink more than one can reasonably consume
greedy.zh: a. 贪婪的, 贪得的, 贪吃的

obtrusive.m:
a. undesirably noticeable
s. sticking out; protruding
obtrusive.zh: a. 强迫人的, 冒失的, 莽撞的, 伸出的

slothful.m: s disinclined to work or exertion
slothful.zh: a. 怠惰的, 懒惰的

sluggish.zh:
a. 偷懒的, 懒惰的, 迟钝的
[经] 萧条的, 呆滞的

impulse.m: n. the act of applying force suddenly
impulse.zh:
n. 冲动, 驱使, 刺激, 推动, 冲力, 建议, 脉冲
vt. 推动

rigid.m:
s. incapable of or resistant to bending
s. incapable of compromise or flexibility
a. designating an airship or dirigible having a form maintained by a stiff unyielding frame or structure
rigid.zh: a. 坚硬的, 刚性的, 严格的, 精密的, 刻板的

stubborn.m: a. tenaciously unwilling or marked by tenacious unwillingness to yield
stubborn.zh: a. 顽固的, 不听话的, 执拗的, 棘手的

stereotype.m: n. a conventional or formulaic conception or image
stereotype.zh:
n. 铅版, 陈规, 老套
vt. 使用铅版, 把...印制成盲文, 套用老套, 使一成不变

daily.m:
n. a newspaper that is published every day
s. of or belonging to or occurring every day
r. every day; without missing a day
daily.zh:
a. 每日的, 日常的
adv. 每日地, 日常地
n. 日报

monthly.m:
n. a periodical that is published every month (or 12 issues per year)
s. of or occurring or payable every month
r. occurring once a month
monthly.zh:
n. 月刊
a. 每月的, 每月一次的

quarterly.m:
n. a periodical that is published every quarter (or four issues per year)
a. of or relating to or consisting of a quarter
r. in diagonally opposed quarters of an escutcheon
r. in three month intervals
quarterly.zh:
a. 季度的, 按季度的, 每季的
adv. 按季, 每三个月, 每季一次
n. 季刊

annual.m:
n. (botany) a plant that completes its entire life cycle within the space of a year
n. a reference book that is published regularly once every year
a. completing its life cycle within a year
s. occurring or payable every year
annual.zh:
n. 年刊, 年报
a. 每年的, 一年一次的, 全年的, 一年生的

yearly.m:
n a reference book that is published regularly once every year
s occurring or payable every year
r without missing a year
yearly.zh:
a. 每年的, 一年一度的
adv. 一年一次, 每年

anniversary.m: n. the date on which an event occurred in some previous year (or the celebration of it)

era.m:
n. a period marked by distinctive character or reckoned from a fixed point or event
n. a major division of geological time; an era is usually divided into two or more periods
era.zh: n. 时代, 纪元, 时期

present.m:
n. the period of time that is happening now; any continuous stretch of time including the moment of speech
n. something presented as a gift
n. a verb tense that expresses actions or states at the time of speaking
v. bring forward and present to the mind
present.zh:
n. 现在, 礼品, 瞄准
a. 现在的, 出席的
vt. 介绍, 引见, 赠送, 提出, 呈现, 上演
vi. 举枪瞄准

contemporary.m:
n. a person of nearly the same age as another
s. characteristic of the present
s. belonging to the present time
contemporary.zh:
n. 同时代的人
a. 同时代的, 属于同一时期的

medieval.m:
a. relating to or belonging to the Middle Ages
s. as if belonging to the Middle Ages; old-fashioned and unenlightened
medieval.zh: a. 中古的, 中世纪的

millennium.m:
n. a span of 1000 years
n. (New Testament) in Revelations it is foretold that those faithful to Jesus will reign with Jesus over the earth for a thousand years; the meaning of these words have been much debated; some denominations (e.g. Jehovah's Witnesses) expect it to be a thousand years of justice and peace and happiness
n. the 1000th anniversary (or the celebration of it)
millennium.zh: n. 千禧年, 一千年

million.m:
n. the number that is represented as a one followed by 6 zeros
n. a very large indefinite number (usually hyperbole)
s. (in Roman numerals, M written with a macron over it) denoting a quantity consisting of 1,000,000 items or units
million.zh:
n. 百万, 无数
num. 百万

billion.m:
n. the number that is represented as a one followed by 12 zeros; in the United Kingdom the usage followed in the United States is frequently seen
n. the number that is represented as a one followed by 9 zeros
s. denoting a quantity consisting of one thousand million items or units in the United States
s. denoting a quantity consisting of one million million items or units in Great Britain

dozen.m:
n the cardinal number that is the sum of eleven and one
s denoting a quantity consisting of 12 items or units
dozen.zh:
n. 打, 十二个
a. 一打的

dawn.m:
n. the first light of day
n. the earliest period
n. an opening time period
v. appear or develop
dawn.zh:
n. 破晓, 黎明
vi. 破晓

midday.m: n the middle of the day
midday.zh:
n. 正午, 中午
a. 正午的

midnight.m: n. 12 o'clock at night; the middle of the night
midnight.zh:
n. 午夜, 子夜, 半夜
a. 午夜的, 半夜的

overnight.m:
r. during or for the length of one night
r. happening in a short time or with great speed
overnight.zh:
n. 前一天晚上, 一夜的逗留
a. 通宵的, 晚上的, 前夜的
adv. 在前一夜, 整夜, 昨晚一晚上

night.m:
n. the time after sunset and before sunrise while it is dark outside
n. a period of ignorance or backwardness or gloom
n. the period spent sleeping
n. the dark part of the diurnal cycle considered a time unit
night.zh:
n. 夜, 夜晚, 晚上, 黑暗, 夜晚的工作
[法] 夜, 黑夜, 黑暗

modern.m:
n. a contemporary person
n. a typeface (based on an 18th century design by Gianbattista Bodoni) distinguished by regular shape and hairline serifs and heavy downstrokes
a. belonging to the modern era; since the Middle Ages
s. characteristic of present-day art and music and literature and architecture
modern.zh:
n. 现代人, 有思想的人
a. 现代的, 时髦的

recent.zh:
a. 最近的, 近代的, 最新的
[经] 最近的, 新进的

up-to-date.m:
s. reflecting the latest information or changes
s. in accord with the most fashionable ideas or style
up-to-date.zh:
a. 直到现在的, 最近的, 现代化的
[化] 最新的

first.m:
n. the first or highest in an ordering or series
n. the first element in a countable series
n. an honours degree of the highest class
a. preceding all others in time or space or degree
first.zh:
adv. 首先, 第一, 优先
a. 第一的
num. 第一
n. 开始, 第一

finally.m: r. after an unspecified period of time or an especially long delay

finish.m:
n. the place designated as the end (as of a race or journey)
n. designated event that concludes a contest (especially a race)
n. the downfall of someone (as of persons on one side of a conflict)
n. (wine tasting) the taste of a wine on the back of the tongue (as it is swallowed)
finish.zh:
n. 完成, 结束, 末道漆, 磨光, 完美
vt. 完成, 结束, 用完, 毁掉
vi. 结束
[计] 完成

immediately.m:
r. without delay or hesitation; with no time intervening
r. near or close by
r. bearing an immediate relation
immediately.zh: adv. 直接地, 立刻, 立即

instant.m: s. in or of the present month
instant.zh:
n. 立即, 瞬间
a. 紧急的, 立即的, 即时的

moment.m:
n. a particular point in time
n. an indefinitely short time
n. a turning force produced by an object acting at a distance (or a measure of that force)
n. the n-th moment of a distribution is the expected value of the n-th power of the deviations from a fixed value
moment.zh:
n. 片刻, 瞬间, 重要, 阶段, 力矩
[医] 片刻, 瞬间, 时机, 因素, 矩

minute.m:
n. a unit of time equal to 60 seconds or 1/60th of an hour
n. a unit of angular distance equal to a 60th of a degree
n. a short note
s. characterized by painstaking care and detailed examination
minute.zh:
n. 分, 分钟, 片刻, 备忘录, 笔记
vt. 记录, 摘录, 测定时间
a. 微小的, 详细的

prior.m: n. the head of a religious order; in an abbey the prior is next below the abbot
prior.zh:
a. 更重要的, 较早的, 在先的
n. 小隐修院院长, 大隐修院副院长

former.m:
n. the first of two or the first mentioned of two
a. referring to the first of two things or persons mentioned (or the earlier one or ones of several); I prefer the former version to the latter one"
s. (used especially of persons) of the immediate past
former.zh:
a. 从前的, 前者的
n. 起形成作用的人(或物), 模型, 样板

preceding.zh:
a. 在前的, 前面的
[法] 在前的, 在先的, 前面的

precedent.m:
n. an example that is used to justify similar occurrences at a later time
n. a subject mentioned earlier (preceding in time)
s. preceding in time, order, or significance
precedent.zh:
n. 先例, 前例
a. 在先的, 在前的

foremost.m:
s. preceding all others in spatial position
s. situated closest to the bow
r. prominently forward
foremost.zh:
a. 最初的, 最重要的
adv. 在最前

opening.m:
n. an open or empty space in or between things
n. a ceremony accompanying the start of some enterprise
n. becoming open or being made open
n. the first performance (as of a theatrical production)
opening.zh:
n. 开始, 口子, 穴, 揭幕
a. 开始的

intermediate.m:
n. a substance formed during a chemical process before the desired product is obtained
a. lying between two extremes in time or space or state
intermediate.zh:
n. 中间物, 调停者, 中级
a. 中间的, 中级的
vi. 起媒介作用
[计] 中级

midst.m: n. the location of something surrounded by other things
midst.zh:
n. 中间
prep. 在...中间

meantime.m:
n the time between one event, process, or period and another
r during the intervening time
meantime.zh:
n. 间隔时间, 其时
adv. 其间

meanwhile.m:
r. at the same time but in another place
r. during the intervening time
meanwhile.zh:
n. 其时, 其间
adv. 同时, 于此时

simultaneous.m: s occurring or operating at the same time
simultaneous.zh:
a. 同时的, 同时发生的
[计] 同时的

ongoing.zh:
a. 前进的, 进行的, 不间断的
n. 前进, 发展

everlasting.m: n. any of various plants of various genera of the family Compositae having flowers that can be dried without loss of form or color
everlasting.zh:
a. 永恒的, 持久的
n. 上帝, 神

permanent.m:
a. continuing or enduring without marked change in status or condition or place
s. not capable of being reversed or returned to the original condition
permanent.zh:
a. 永久的, 不变的, 固定的, 持久的
n. 烫发
[计] 永久的

punctual.m: a. acting or arriving or performed exactly at the time appointed
punctual.zh:
a. 准时的, 守时的, 点状的, 中肯的
[经] 准时的, 不误期的, 准时

duration.m:
n. the period of time during which something continues
n. the property of enduring or continuing in time
n. continuance in time
duration.zh:
n. 持续时间, 持续
[计] 持续时间

consecutive.m:
s. in regular succession without gaps
r. in a consecutive manner
consecutive.zh:
a. 连续的, 联贯的
[计] 连续的; 连接的

periodically.zh: adv. 定期, 循环, 间歇, 周期, 定期刊行, 期刊

imminent.m: s close in time; about to occur
imminent.zh: a. 即将来临的, 逼近的

incidentally.m: r. of a minor or subordinate nature
incidentally.zh: adv. 伴随地, 偶然, 顺便
